annotation.authors_or_issuer: Nisevic, M.; Kulenovic, H.; Milojevic, D.; Levak, J.; Biasin, E.
key_provisions_or_claims: Identifies a gap in medical professionals' awareness of applicable EU legal frameworks.
Identifies eight key factors influencing liability, including explainability, training data quality, cybersecurity and doctor-patient dynamics.
Proposes a dual ex-ante (preventive) and ex-post (remedial) liability framework.
Proposes link-in-the-chain liability models distributing liability among developers, deployers and users.
Calls for a harmonized, context-sensitive EU framework, collaborative governance and training for medical professionals.
annotation.summary_en: Interdisciplinary review combining a survey of medical professionals in 20 countries, expert interviews, literature and legal analysis of the AI Act, GDPR, MDR and revised PLD. It proposes a dual ex-ante/ex-post liability framework with link-in-the-chain models for AI-powered medical robots, and calls for harmonized EU rules and professional training.
annotation.title_clean: Regulatory challenges and liability pathways for AI-powered robots in EU medical practice
annotation.title_en: Regulatory challenges and liability pathways for AI-powered robots in EU medical practice
